reviews.comment: SOCI205 with Dr. Evans was a good experience. Her exams are online in Canvas and do not have to be taken in class. Attendance was not mandatory, but her lectures were captivating. Gets material across clearly while providing anecdotal experience and classroom discussions. Highly recommend.

easiest class ever. she cares about all of her studetns and loves to talk to them before and after class. attendance isnt mandatory and posts slides and exams and quizzes online. Video project at the end of the class and thats the hardest part and theres also feedback on everything you do. TAKE HER!
She really cares about her students. All her exams were online with no lockdown browser. You can have 3 unexcused absences. Highly recommend.
Great prof, work breakdown accurate in other reviews.

Attendance is mandatory, there is going to be 10 assignments and then a research proposal towards the end which takes up a lot of time but is over all those assignments you do so it will be easy. I recommend doing the extra credit. Take this prof, she's very nice!

I really enjoyed taking this class! The exams, project, and out-of-class assignments were simple and straightforward, but it made me think critically which I enjoyed. I attended every lecture because she had in-class assignments, but I loved how passionate she was about sociology! It is extremely easy to get an A if you put the effort in.
TAKE HER TAKE HER TAKE HER!!!!! Attendance is mandatory but she makes her lectures interesting! I loved her! :)

This class is very manageable to get through for those that have a busy schedule. She does have in-class assignments, meaning attendance is mandatory, but her lectures are pretty interesting! The exams are extremely straightforward, and the essays aren't that difficult to complete. As long as you put decent work in, it's an easy A!
reviews.ratingTags: Participation matters--Clear grading criteria--So many papers

reviews.comment: Dr. Rhonda Evans is extremely brilliant! You can tell she cares about her students a lot and what she lectures. She is an amazing professor and I 100% recommend being in her classes.

Such a sweet and nice person. She really cares about the students. Attendence is mandatory, but you get 4 unexcused absences. Not too many assignments, about one each week with a final assignment. No exams. Does have an extra credit opportunity.
Just make sure you read the syllabus
reviews.ratingTags: Clear grading criteria--Caring--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Very easy class. Go to class for the first 3 attendance grades after that attendance does not matter. I quit going to class after the first month. Take this for easy grade.

She was really awesome and very laid back. If you look at the schedule ahead of time you only need to go in 3 times in the entire semester because she has 3 graded in class activities. Other than those 3 days I have never showed up to class and it was really chill. Awesome Prof!!!!
reviews.ratingTags: EXTRA CREDIT--Group projects--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: This class was so easy. You don't need to buy the textbook. A million assignment opportunities and only need to complete a few. test online and not proctored. review session the class before the test where she tells u all the answers. syllabus is clear and she sticks to it. obviously liberal, but so are the majority of the profs here so wtv.
reviews.ratingTags: EXTRA CREDIT--Clear grading criteria--Lots of homework

reviews.comment: TAKE TAKE TAKE HER! This was a very laid-back class. Exams are online and not proctored. A couple short essays and data workshops to do throughout the semester, but very easy and simple.

I took her for SOCI 220 and it was a very relaxed laid back course that included one weekly in class assignment that was graded and one weekly out of class assignment both were extremely easy and graded fairly. I would definitely take her again and enjoyed the course

Dr. Evans was such a great prof! If you are looking for a GPA booster, I highly recommend taking her. She explains the textbook in class during lectures, so there is NO NEED to buy it. She is extremely caring and has always been happy to help or explain something I didn't understand. Overall, I highly recommend it!!!

The textbook is unnecessary imo. Easy class with many assignments that are all very simple. But as other ratings have stated, she has a very "woke" opinion which is obvious in all her lectures and need to use that in assignments. She seems to think women and racial minorities are helpless victims in society, and this is coming from a POC woman.

Prof Evan was a very good professor. her lectures were very interesting and she cares a lot about her students. Some topics are sensitive but she is very understanding if you need to leave. The assignments were really easy and her tests were online and also easy as long as you pay attention in class.

She did not teach purely sociology, but seemed to try to convince you of her "woke" beliefs.

Her beliefs that can influence people do not belong in a college course. Woke agenda was unavoidable in homework.
She said women are supposed to sit like a lady "to take up less space." Clearly not true. Should not be spoken of as fact.

Easy A though.

This class was incredibly easy, I stopped going early in the semester and still ended with an A. Evans seems like a great person and cares a lot about the subject but is pretty left-leaning or "woke", kind of have to incorporate that into your assignments. Keep track of assignment due dates, there's no pattern so they sneak up! But super easy.

Easiest class ever.  She gives 12 short answers which don't take much time at all and drops the lowest 3,  5 data workshops which takes a bit more time and drops 2.  The tests are online, not proctored, open note, and she does a review session the class before and gives you every answer.  If you need to take this class, take it with her.
Dr. Evans has probably about 2-3 assignments a week, which in my case, snuck up on me. Lectures are straight forward and all information needed is easily laid out on her syllabus.
